usage: Jau4 seoi2 can be used as a noun to refer to the activity or sport of swimming.
Jau4 seoi2 can also be used as a verb meaning 'to swim', indicating the action of moving in water.
When used as a verb, jau4 seoi2 often appears with a particle like 'zo2' (咗) to show the past action, for example, 'jau4 seoi2 zo2' (游水咗) means 'swam'.
Jau4 seoi2 is commonly used in everyday conversation related to sports, fitness, and leisure activities involving water.
This word can be combined with locations or times to specify when or where swimming happens, like 'hai2 ceoi4 seoi2 jau4 seoi2' (喺泳池游水) - 'swim in the pool'.
